hĭlărĭtūdo , ĭnis, f. hilaris,
I.cheerfulness, merriment (ante-class. for the class. hilaritas): numquam ego te tristiorem Vidi esse: quid cedo tam abhorret hilaritudo? Plaut. Cist. 1, 1, 56: “onera te hilaritudine,” id. Mil. 3, 1, 83 : “ut in ocellis hilaritudo est!” id. Rud. 2, 4, 8 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
